source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: Sticky or slippery? Snails can change their slime to meet the moment
articles.summary: 蜗牛不仅能分泌黏液，还能按需调节黏液的性质——研究发现了五种功能各异的黏液，未来或可用于伤口封闭、药物输送等新材料的研发。

sentences.en: Slime is splattered across the animal kingdom.
sentences.zh: 黏液遍布整个动物界。

sentences.en: Snail slime specifically is fascinating — a natural work of art.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，蜗牛的黏液令人着迷——它是大自然的一件艺术品。

sentences.en: The complexity and functionality are mesmerizing.
sentences.zh: 它的复杂性与功能性令人着迷。

sentences.en: Gabler and her colleagues wanted to know more about the composition of the slime of a particular kind of terrestrial species native to central Europe.
sentences.zh: 加布勒和她的同事想更多地了解一种原产于中欧的陆生物种的黏液成分。

sentences.en: These snails tune the relative proportions of certain proteins and ions to create five different types of mucus.
sentences.zh: 这些蜗牛调节某些蛋白质和离子的相对比例，制造出五种不同的黏液。

sentences.en: Each type of mucus has its own function and distinctive properties.
sentences.zh: 每种黏液都有自己独特的功能与特性。

sentences.en: Understanding how the snails make different types of slime could serve engineers well in the creation of new materials.
sentences.zh: 了解蜗牛如何制造不同类型的黏液，能对工程师创造新材料大有帮助。

sentences.en: She points to numerous potential applications, including developing a slime that might help seal a wound or deliver a drug.
sentences.zh: 她指出了许多潜在用途，包括开发一种可能有助于封合伤口或输送药物的黏液。

sentences.en: The snails use a sticky, yet slippery lubricant mucus for locomotion, allowing them to adhere to a surface while gliding along with minimal friction.
sentences.zh: 蜗牛利用一种黏稠又顺滑的润滑黏液来移动，使它们能在极小摩擦下附着于表面并滑行。

sentences.en: When it feels stressed or threatened, it can produce a sticky glue to immobilize small pests.
sentences.zh: 当它感到紧张或受到威胁时，能分泌出黏胶来使小害虫无法动弹。

grammar: 现在分词作结果/伴随状语：allowing them to adhere to a surface while gliding along 中，allowing 表示“使它们能够附着表面并滑行”的自然结果，while gliding 是“连词+现在分词”的省略结构。
定语从句：a particular kind of terrestrial species that's native to central Europe 中，that 引导定语从句修饰 species，be native to 表示“原产于”。
不定式作目的状语：to create five different types of mucus 与 to know more about... 都是不定式表目的。
一般过去时表已发生的科研动作：wanted to know / tune / reveal 用一般过去时，陈述研究者的具体动作与发现。
过去分词作后置定语：a paper published in the journal Science 中，published 过去分词修饰 paper，表被动“被发表在”。
并列连词 either...or...：either a foam ... or a sticky glue 表示“要么……要么……”，列举两种情况。

articles.title: A Sri Lanka wildlife park is an elephant haven
articles.summary: 斯里兰卡人与大象的冲突日益加剧，但中部 Hurulu 生态公园却成为大象自由吃草的避难所。记者在彩虹下邂逅大象，也感受到当地人对大象的敬重。

sentences.en: For days, we met farmers as they prepared for the spring rice sowing season in central Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 一连几天，我们遇到了正在斯里兰卡中部为春季水稻播种季做准备的农民。

sentences.en: They told us about elephants trampling their crops, and how they tried to push them back with firecrackers and lit torches.
sentences.zh: 他们向我们讲述了大象踩踏庄稼，以及他们如何试图用鞭炮和火把把大象赶走。

sentences.en: Encounters between elephants and farmers have killed hundreds on both sides in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，大象与农民的相遇已导致双方数百人死亡。

sentences.en: Most of Sri Lanka's 7,400 elephants live freely across the island, but conflict has ensued as their habitats are being converted to intensive agriculture.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡 7400 头大象中的大部分在岛上自由生活，但随着它们的栖息地被改造成集约化农业用地，冲突随之而来。

sentences.en: To meet some of the elephants, we drove through the Hurulu Eco Park, where they graze freely in the confines of the park.
sentences.zh: 为了见见一些大象，我们驱车穿过 Hurulu 生态公园，它们在公园范围内自由吃草。

sentences.en: After bouncing on dirt roads for an hour, we turned onto a path.
sentences.zh: 在土路上颠簸了一个小时后，我们拐上一条小道。

sentences.en: A rainbow stretched across the sky, and an elephant ambled through it.
sentences.zh: 一道彩虹横跨天空，一头大象慢悠悠地穿行其中。

sentences.en: This conflict has two victims, because elephants are revered here.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突有两个受害者，因为大象在这里受人敬重。

grammar: as 引导时间状语从句：as they prepared for the spring rice sowing season 中，as 表示“当……时候”。
现在进行时的被动：their habitats are being converted to intensive agriculture 表示“栖息地正在被改造成……”，强调进行中的被动动作。
现在完成时：Encounters ... have killed hundreds 用 have + 过去分词，表示过去动作对现在造成的影响。
不定式作目的状语：To meet some of the elephants, we drove... 中，to do 置于句首表目的。
关系副词 where 引导定语从句：the Hurulu Eco Park, where they graze freely 中，where 指代地点，在从句中作状语。
并列句：A rainbow stretched across the sky, and an elephant ambled through it. 由 and 连接两个并列分句，描述先后画面。

articles.title: How an AI chatbot is searching for art looted by the Nazis
articles.summary: 超过 60 万件艺术品在二战中被纳粹掠夺，至今仍有十余万件无人认领。圣克拉拉大学团队研发“AI 溯源助手”，用聊天机器人帮助人们跨数据库搜寻失散的艺术品。

sentences.en: More than 600,000 artworks and other cultural objects were stolen by the Nazis leading up to and during World War II.
sentences.zh: 在二战前夕及期间，超过 60 万件艺术品和其他文化物品被纳粹窃取，其中大部分属于犹太人。

sentences.en: Efforts to restore the more than 100,000 as-yet-unclaimed artifacts have been on the uptick.
sentences.zh: 旨在归还十余万件尚未认领文物的努力一直在增加。

sentences.en: The President signed the Holocaust Expropriated Art Recovery Act into law, which put an end to legal loopholes.
sentences.zh: 总统将《大屠杀被征用艺术品追回法案》签署成法，从而终结了相关法律漏洞。

sentences.en: But reclaiming these artifacts is often a long and fraught process.
sentences.zh: 但追回这些文物往往是一个漫长而棘手的过程。

sentences.en: There's no central repository, no database that's telling you where that art is.
sentences.zh: 没有一个中央储存库，也没有一个能告诉你那些艺术品在哪里的数据库。

sentences.en: To recreate the historical record of what actually happened to the family is very difficult.
sentences.zh: 要重建这个家庭及其艺术品究竟遭遇了什么的历史记录，非常困难。

sentences.en: A team at Santa Clara University is aspiring to do just that, with a new AI chatbot.
sentences.zh: 圣克拉拉大学的一个团队正渴望借助一款新的人工智能聊天机器人做到这一点。

sentences.en: The AI Provenance Assistant is testing how artificial intelligence could eventually make it easier for people to search archives of stolen art.
sentences.zh: 这款“AI 溯源助手”正在测试人工智能最终如何让人们更轻松地检索被盗艺术品的档案。

sentences.en: We are applying AI tools to make it easier to make the kinds of connections that seasoned researchers would have to spend a long time doing manually.
sentences.zh: 我们正应用人工智能工具，让资深研究者需要花很长时间手动完成的那些关联变得更容易。

sentences.en: The tool is more intuitive than the database because it doesn't require users to deal with drop-down menus.
sentences.zh: 这个工具比那个数据库更直观，因为它不需要用户去处理下拉菜单。

vocab.zh: 充满（问题）的；令人担忧的

grammar: 过去分词作后置定语：artworks ... stolen by the Nazis 中，stolen 修饰 artworks，表示被动“被窃取”。
现在完成进行时：have been on the uptick 表示“一直在增加”，强调从过去持续到现在的状态。
非限制性定语从句：which put an end to legal loopholes 中，which 指代前面整件事（签署法案）。
动名词作主语：reclaiming these artifacts is often a long and fraught process 中，动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is。
比较级 + than：more intuitive than the database 是形容词比较级结构，表示“比……更直观”。
that 引导的定语从句嵌套：the kinds of connections that seasoned researchers would... 中 that 修饰 connections，从句内含 would have to 的虚拟语气。

articles.title: Selling experiences, not things: Services overtake physical goods in downtown retail
articles.summary: 美国市中心零售正在变天：健身房、美发沙龙、体验店取代卖实物的商店。消费者把更多开支从商品转向服务，出门购物为的是乐趣与体验，而非单纯买东西。

sentences.en: America's downtowns are changing. Storefronts that used to showcase clothes or gifts are giving way to gyms and salons.
sentences.zh: 美国市中心正在改变。曾经展示服装或礼品的店面，正让位于健身房和美发沙龙。

sentences.en: Last year marked the first time that more retail space went to shops offering services rather than things.
sentences.zh: 去年是第一次出现更多零售空间流向提供服务的店铺，而非卖实物的店铺。

sentences.en: In the 20 biggest cities, retail tenants are declining for the third year in a row, while personal services and entertainment are ballooning.
sentences.zh: 在最大的 20 座城市里，零售租户连续第三年减少，而个人服务与娱乐业态却在激增。

sentences.en: Over the very long term, consumers have switched a lot of spending from retail goods to services.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，消费者已将大量支出从实体零售商品转向服务。

sentences.en: Consumers don't need to go to physical spaces to make a purchase anymore.
sentences.zh: 消费者不再需要去实体店就能完成购买。

sentences.en: Everything is at your fingertips online, which means people who go out to shop are looking for fun, an activity.
sentences.zh: 一切在网上都触手可及，这意味着出门购物的人是在寻找乐趣和体验。

sentences.en: You can't stroll Amazon.
sentences.zh: 你没法在亚马逊上闲逛。

sentences.en: A dinner or a hair appointment becomes a singular destination, and people don't build in time to wander around.
sentences.zh: 一顿晚餐或一次美发预约成了单一目的地，人们不会特意留出时间四处逛逛。

sentences.en: More beautiful shops get people to shop more, while more restaurants don't.
sentences.zh: 更漂亮的店铺能让人买得更多，而更多的餐厅却做不到。

sentences.en: They snack and shop, buying things and little treats along the way.
sentences.zh: 他们边吃零食边购物，一路上买些东西和小零食。

vocab.zh: 指尖（at one's fingertips 触手可及）

grammar: 定语从句 + used to：Storefronts that used to showcase clothes 中 that 引导定语从句，used to do 表示“过去常常（现在不）”。
现在进行时表渐变趋势：are giving way to / are declining / are ballooning 用现在进行时描述正在发生的变化。
while 表对比：retail tenants are declining ... while personal services ... are ballooning，while 连接两种相反趋势。
现在完成时：consumers have switched a lot of spending 强调过去动作对现在的影响。
非限制性定语从句：Everything is at your fingertips online, which means... 中 which 指代前面整句。
情态动词否定 need to：don't need to go 表示“不必去”，说明线上购物带来的改变。

articles.title: Comic: 3 types of financial guilt and how to cope
articles.summary: 花钱太多会后悔、给家人太少会内疚？理财规划师劳琳·威廉姆斯把这种情绪称为“财务内疚”，并拆解三类成因与应对方法，提醒别让内疚阻碍你改善财务或享受生活。

sentences.en: Ever regretted spending too much on dinner? Or ashamed about not being able to give a family member more financial support?
sentences.zh: 有没有为在晚餐上花太多钱而后悔过？或者因为无法给家人更多经济支持而感到羞愧？

sentences.en: There's a term for this feeling, says certified financial planner Lauryn Williams: financial guilt.
sentences.zh: “认证理财规划师劳琳·威廉姆斯说，这种感觉有个名称：财务内疚。”

sentences.en: And it can hold you back from taking steps to fix your finances — or enjoying the money you do have.
sentences.zh: 而它会阻碍你采取行动去改善财务状况——或者享受你已有的钱。

sentences.en: Narratives like "I should have known better" or "I shouldn't be in this situation" don't help, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，诸如“我本该更明智”或“我不该处于这种境地”这样的内心独白毫无帮助。

sentences.en: They don't allow you to move forward because you feel so guilty.
sentences.zh: 它们不让你向前走，因为你感到太内疚了。

sentences.en: Williams, the founder of the financial planning firm Worth Winning, shares three kinds of financial guilt and how to address them.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯是理财公司 Worth Winning 的创始人，她分享了三种财务内疚的类型以及应对方法。

sentences.en: If spending money makes you feel shame or regret, you might be grappling with financial guilt.
sentences.zh: 如果花钱——或不花钱——让你感到羞愧或后悔，你可能正陷入财务内疚。

sentences.en: Financial guilt can hold you back from enjoying the money you do have.
sentences.zh: 财务内疚会让你无法享受你手头的钱。

grammar: 疑问句省略主语 you：Ever regretted spending too much on dinner? 是 Have you ever regretted... 的口语省略，regret doing sth 表示“后悔做过某事”。
动名词作宾语：regretted spending / hold you back from taking steps 中，动词或介词后接动名词。
虚拟语气 should have done：I should have known better 表示“我本该更明智（实际没有）”，用来表达后悔。
并列连词 or 连接相反情况：spending — or not spending — 表示“花钱或不花钱”两种情形。
省略 that 的定语从句：the money (that) you do have 中 that 被省略，do have 的 do 起强调作用，“你确实拥有的钱”。
if 真实条件句：If spending money makes you feel..., you might be grappling... 中 might 表示可能性，用于推测。

articles.title: A solar eclipse happens this week. Here is what to know
articles.summary: 本周三欧美多地将迎来日食：冰岛、西班牙等地可见全食，美国北部可见偏食。文章还提醒务必使用日食眼镜保护眼睛，并介绍科学家借机研究太阳日冕。

sentences.en: People throughout Europe and parts of the U.S. will be treated to a chance to see a solar eclipse on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 周三，欧洲各地和美国部分地区的人们将有幸看到一次日食。

sentences.en: People in Iceland, Greenland, northern Russia, Spain, and a part of Portugal will see a total eclipse.
sentences.zh: 冰岛、格陵兰、俄罗斯北部、西班牙和葡萄牙部分地区的人们将看到全食。

sentences.en: That's when the moon passes between the Earth and the Sun, fully blocking the Sun's face.
sentences.zh: 那时月亮运行到地球和太阳之间，完全遮住太阳的表面。

sentences.en: During a partial solar eclipse, the moon passes between the sun and Earth, but the celestial bodies are not perfectly aligned.
sentences.zh: 在日偏食期间，月亮运行到太阳和地球之间，但天体并未完全对齐。

sentences.en: Because only parts of the sun are obscured, the sun appears as a crescent shape.
sentences.zh: 因为只有部分太阳被遮挡，太阳呈现新月形。

sentences.en: The partial eclipse is expected to begin around 1:17 p.m. ET in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 据 NASA，这次日偏食预计在华盛顿特区东部时间下午 1:17 左右开始。

sentences.en: Special equipment such as eclipse glasses will be necessary to protect one's eyes.
sentences.zh: 诸如日食眼镜之类的特殊设备是保护眼睛所必需的。

sentences.en: Looking at the sun can cause significant eye damage, including burns and even permanent vision loss.
sentences.zh: 直视太阳会造成严重的眼部损伤，包括灼伤甚至永久性视力丧失。

sentences.en: Some scientists will use it as an opportunity to better understand the sun.
sentences.zh: 一些科学家会把它当作更好地了解太阳的机会。

sentences.en: From our unique perspective on Earth, scientists can study the Sun's corona in a way we can't from anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 从地球独特的视角，科学家能以太阳系其他地方无法做到的方式研究太阳的日冕。

grammar: 一般将来时被动：will be treated to / will be necessary / will be covered 用将来时被动，描述将要发生的事。
现在分词作结果状语：fully blocking the Sun's face 中 blocking 表示“完全遮住”的自然结果。
原因状语从句：Because only parts of the sun are obscured, ... 用 because 引导原因。
定语从句：For those who plan to watch... 中 who 引导定语从句修饰 those。
动名词作主语：Looking at the sun can cause... 中动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 can cause。
介词 + which 省略的定语从句：in a way (that) we can't from anywhere else 修饰 way，表示“以某种方式”。

articles.title: Magnitude 7.4 quake rocks western Colombia, killing at least 111 people
articles.summary: 哥伦比亚西部发生 7.4 级强震，至少 111 人遇难、约 1600 栋建筑受损。震中位于乔科地区，总统宣布紧急状态；该区域地处“火环”地震带。

sentences.en: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on Monday, killing at least 111 people.
sentences.zh: 周一，一场强烈的 7.4 级地震袭击了哥伦比亚西部，造成至少 111 人死亡。

sentences.en: Search teams and civilians picked through the remains of destroyed buildings.
sentences.zh: 搜救队和民众在毁坏建筑的残骸中翻找。

sentences.en: Our building has basically been left in ruins, and the building next to ours completely collapsed.
sentences.zh: 我们的楼基本成了一片废墟，而旁边的楼完全倒塌了。

sentences.en: The quake ravaged cities across western Colombia and was felt in neighboring Ecuador and Panama.
sentences.zh: 地震摧残了哥伦比亚西部多座城市，并在邻国厄瓜多尔和巴拿马都有震感。

sentences.en: The epicenter was in San Jose del Palmar, a community of about 4,800 people.
sentences.zh: 震中位于圣何塞德尔帕尔马，一个约 4800 人的社区。

sentences.en: Colombia's President said at least 87 people were injured and around 1,600 buildings were damaged.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚总统表示，至少 87 人受伤，约 1600 栋建筑受损。

sentences.en: He declared an emergency to expedite funding for the quake recovery.
sentences.zh: 他宣布进入紧急状态，以加快地震恢复资金的拨付。

sentences.en: Monday's quake was the country's strongest recorded in the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 周一的地震是该国有记录以来 21 世纪最强的一次。

sentences.en: Colombia's Pacific region lies along the 'Ring of Fire,' where most of the world's earthquakes occur.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚太平洋沿岸地区位于“火环”带上，世界上大多数地震都发生在那里。

sentences.en: By Monday afternoon, people had begun reporting their loved ones missing on digital databases.
sentences.zh: 到周一下午，人们已开始在数字数据库上登记失踪的亲人。

grammar: 现在分词作结果/伴随状语：killing at least 111 people, damaging hundreds of buildings and leaving many trapped 三个并列现在分词作结果状语。
现在完成时被动：has basically been left in ruins / were injured / were damaged 用被动语态描述已发生状态。
过去完成时：By Monday afternoon, people had begun reporting... 表示“到过去某时为止已经……”。
定语从句：a community of about 4,800 people / where most of the world's earthquakes occur 用关系词引导定语。
一般过去时被动：was felt in neighboring... / were killed 描述已发生且强调受事者。
不定式作目的状语：to expedite funding for the quake recovery 中 to do 表目的“为了加快……”。

articles.title: Nicotine pouches can be marketed as 'lower risk' than cigarettes. Is that dangerous?
articles.summary: FDA 批准 Zyn 尼古丁袋囊以“比香烟风险更低”宣传。支持者认为它能帮吸烟者减害戒烟，反对者则担心它会诱导青少年成瘾，并强调尼古丁并非无风险。

sentences.en: It comes in flavors like 'Cool Mint,' 'Smooth' and 'Chill.'
sentences.zh: 它有“酷薄荷”“顺滑”“清凉”等口味。

sentences.en: A paperclip-size pouch placed between the lip and gum leeches nicotine into the user's bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 一个回形针大小的袋囊放在嘴唇和牙龈之间，会把尼古丁渗入使用者的血液。

sentences.en: The FDA authorized the company to advertise that using Zyn instead of cigarettes puts you at a lower risk of mouth cancer.
sentences.zh: FDA 授权该公司宣传：用 Zyn 替代香烟能降低你患口腔癌的风险。

sentences.en: The decision is intended to ensure that adult users have clear, science-based information about the relative harms of tobacco products.
sentences.zh: 该决定旨在确保成年使用者获得关于烟草制品相对危害的清晰、基于科学的信息。

sentences.en: Some researchers say Zyn is a safer alternative to cigarettes and can help curb the deaths attributable to tobacco each year.
sentences.zh: 一些研究者说 Zyn 是比香烟更安全的替代品，有助于减少每年可归因于烟草的死亡。

sentences.en: Others say it can be a gateway to riskier nicotine habits like smoking and hook people in adolescence.
sentences.zh: 另一些人说它可能成为通往更危险尼古丁习惯（如吸烟）的入口，并在青少年中让人上瘾。

sentences.en: Nicotine is a drug extracted from the tobacco plant.
sentences.zh: 尼古丁是从烟草植物中提取的一种药物。

sentences.en: The pouches are demonstrably less harmful than burning tobacco leaves and inhaling the chemicals in tobacco smoke.
sentences.zh: 这些袋囊明显比燃烧烟叶、吸入烟草烟雾中的化学物质危害更小。

sentences.en: When it comes to heavy smokers who want to quit, it's a no-brainer to switch to nicotine pouches.
sentences.zh: 对于想戒烟的重度吸烟者来说，改用尼古丁袋囊是不用动脑筋的选择。

sentences.en: Nicotine is addictive and is not risk-free.
sentences.zh: 尼古丁会让人上瘾，并非没有风险。

grammar: 过去分词作后置定语：A paperclip-size pouch placed between... / a drug extracted from... 中过去分词短语修饰名词，表被动。
现在分词作结果状语：allowing anyone to use nicotine discreetly 中 allowing 表示“使得……”的结果。
动名词作主语：Using Zyn instead of cigarettes puts you at a lower risk 中动名词短语作主语。
比较级：demonstrably less harmful than... / lower risk 是“更……比……”的比较结构。
定语从句：tobacco products that users burn / heavy smokers who want to quit 用 that/who 引导定语从句。
it is + n. + to do 结构：it's a no-brainer to switch... 中 it 为形式主语，to switch 为真正主语，no-brainer 表示“显而易见的事”。
